title: Laparoscopic Dor Versus Toupet Fundoplication for the Treatment of Idiopathic Esophageal Achalasia
brief_summary: The primary aim of this study is to test the hypothesis that Heller myotomy and Toupet fundoplication result in a lower rate of reflux symptoms and positive 24-hour pH testing when compared to Heller myotomy and Dor fundoplication.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of Achalasia

Exclusion Criteria:

* Prior heller myotomy
